title: strict-ts.json
description: The configuration of strict-ts, read beside tsconfig.json. Every key is optional.

$schema.description: The path or URL of this schema, for the editor.

unsafeDirs.description: The directories where unchecked code may live, relative to the project root: the equivalent of `unsafe` in Rust.

allowedImports.description: The packages safe code may import. Everything else is imported from an unsafe directory only.

rules.description: The rules to run. All of them when absent.

baseline.description: The path of the baseline file, relative to the project root.
